meta.title: Nick Lukashik — Senior full-stack engineer
meta.description: Senior full-stack engineer. Fast interfaces, reliable backends and the infrastructure that ships them. TypeScript, React, Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes.

hero.description: I design fast interfaces, build reliable backends and ship them on infrastructure I run myself — from the first pixel to the cluster.

expertise.label: Expertise
expertise.title: Depth across
expertise.intro: 6+ years in the JavaScript ecosystem. I connect what people see with the systems they rely on — and own it in production.

items.title: Interfaces that feel right
items.body: Fast, accessible products with careful interaction design — from e-commerce journeys to the admin tools behind them.

items.title: Systems that hold up
items.body: Clear service boundaries, reliable data flows and APIs that keep complex products easy to change.

items.title: From code to production
items.body: Reproducible delivery and real visibility after launch. Infrastructure is part of the product.

items.title: AI-first delivery
items.body: Agents write and review alongside me; contracts, tests and human judgement stay the gate.

items.title: Think in systems.
items.body: Start with the problem, the constraints and the people involved. Make the architecture serve the product.

items.title: Build for people.
items.body: A responsive interface, a clear error, a faster page. Small decisions add up to a product people enjoy using.

items.title: Own the delivery.
items.body: Connect the interface, backend and deployment. Verify the result and keep the system understandable.

platform.label: Platform
platform.title: The platform
platform.intro: outegro.dev is the first product on a platform I am building from scratch: one sign-in, notifications, payments and an admin console shared by every future app — on a single-node K3s cluster.
